title: Existing smooth-section geometry and normal-bundle integration adjuncts
statement: Let $V,S$ be schemes of universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme], $d\in\mathbf N$, $g:V\to S$ and $s:S\hookrightarrow V$ a closed immersion. Let $\mathcal I$ be its ideal, $\mathcal E=\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2$, and $\operatorname{gr}_{\mathcal I}\mathcal O_V$ its conormal graded algebra [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra]. Define $\mathrm{Geometry}(d,g,s)$ as the proposition collecting: the affine line over $S$, $V$, the actual extended-Rees deformation $\operatorname{Spec}_V\mathcal O_V[t,\mathcal I/t]$, and its actual zero fibre are Noetherian; the deformation map to $\mathbf A^1_S$ is smooth of pure relative dimension $d$, separated, compactifiable and quasi-compact; the zero-fibre projection is compactifiable and quasi-compact; $\mathcal E$ is locally free of rank $d$; the canonical symmetric-algebra comparison $\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)\to\operatorname{gr}_{\mathcal I}\mathcal O_V$ is invertible; and around every point of $s(S)$ the ideal is generated by a weakly regular sequence indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}(d)$. The smooth and compactification terminology is that of [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and [def-asd-compactifiable]. This defines a proposition and does not assert that it holds. If $S$ is Noetherian and Geometry holds, define $\mathrm{coneBundleIso}$ by relative Spec of that symmetric-algebra comparison, from the relative-Spec graded cone to $\operatorname{Spec}_S\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)$ [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]; its recorded specification is compatibility with projection and, when $g\circ s=1_S$, zero section. For a finite commutative ring $A$ of universe $u+1$, define $\mathrm{bundleRight}(A,S,d,M)$ for a rank-$d$ locally free module $M$ as the ordinary etale compact-support right adjoint of its vector-bundle projection [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], using the existing bundle compactification. For $N>0$ annihilating $A$ and invertible on $S$, define $\mathrm{bundleAdjoint}:A_E(d)[2d]\to\pi^\times A_S$ as the adjunct of the fixed Kummer-normalized vector-bundle integration [def-amb-vector-integration]. Define $\mathrm{bundleSectionAdjoint}$ by inverse image under the zero section, preceded by the inverse section-composition constraint identifying its source with $A_S(d)[2d]$. All complexes and inverse images are in the ordinary constant-coefficient etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. These are the existing constructions; no section-deformation or purity existence assertion is included.
